qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507.mistake: The FOL statement ¬p_12(Jocelyn) → ¬p_5(Jocelyn) is the contrapositive of p_5(Jocelyn) → p_12(Jocelyn), which would mean 'If Jocelyn studies transuranic elements, then she drives innovation.' But the natural language says 'If she does not drive innovation, then she does not study transuranic elements,' which implies driving innovation is necessary for studying transuranic elements — a reversal of the actual dependency. There is no justification in the original statements to support that not driving innovation entails not studying transuranic elements. This misrepresents the causal or logical relationship, making the FOL incorrectly represent the NL. Thus, the mapping is flawed.
